name: MYC proto-oncogene, bHLH transcription factor

function.text: MYC encodes a transcription factor that dimerizes with MAX to regulate gene-expression programs controlling growth, metabolism, proliferation, and differentiation.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Angiosarcoma; Pineoblastoma; Medulloblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
